paths.title: 内容桌（窄席 + 人审发布）
paths.summary: 选一栏内容，只开一名协调员加窄席。先写 brief，再产出，发布前必须人点头。对照 Jessica Temporal 的编制和 How Do I Use AI 的小队 rollout——席位要少，闸门要硬。
paths.summaryEn: Pick one column. One coordinator plus a narrow roster. Write the brief, produce, then a human nods before anything publishes. Use Jessica Temporal’s roster and How Do I Use AI’s team rollout as references — few seats, hard gates.

steps.title: 只选一栏
steps.body: 本周只做一个栏目：周记、产品笔记、或一条站内说明。不要同时开销售、工程、营销三桌。
steps.bodyEn: Run one column this week: a lab note, a product note, or one site page. Do not open sales, engineering, and marketing desks at once.

steps.title: 一名协调员 + 窄席
steps.body: 协调员分派；写手、校对各一席就够。Jessica 的六席周末交付可以对照编制，本实验室先压到能盯住的人数。
steps.bodyEn: The coordinator assigns; writer and reviewer are enough. Jessica’s six-seat Saturday is a roster reference — this lab starts at a count one person can watch.

steps.title: 先写 brief
steps.body: 受众、口吻、禁止项、完成定义。没有 brief 不开工。How Do I Use AI 的节奏是一任务 → skill → routine，这里先停在「一任务」。
steps.bodyEn: Audience, voice, forbidden moves, definition of done. No brief, no work. How Do I Use AI goes task → skill → routine; this path stops at one task.

steps.title: 产出停在待审
steps.body: 草稿进同一条线程，不外发、不改已上线页。协调员只收齐，不代发。
steps.bodyEn: Drafts stay in the same thread. No outbound, no live-page edits. The coordinator collects; they do not publish.

steps.title: 人点头再发布
steps.body: 栏目主人看过再发。没有人审就没有发布。这是整条路径的闸门，不是可选项。
steps.bodyEn: The column owner reads it, then publishes. No human nod, no publish. That gate is the path, not an option.

gates.title: 无人点头不发布
gates.titleEn: No publish without a human nod
gates.body: 不发帖、不改已上线页、不代发 Newsletter 或社媒。Bot 只交草稿。
gates.bodyEn: No posts, no live-page edits, no sending a newsletter or social queue. Bots return drafts only.

paths.title: AI UP LAB 营销桌（草稿停笔）
paths.titleEn: AI UP LAB marketing desk (drafts stop here)
paths.summary: Lead → Writer → Reviewer，只为 X/@mostdes7gn 或站内笔记出草稿。编制灵感来自公开的四席营销队，但本实验室不设 Publisher，也不接 Blotato。Hao 自己发；X 连接器只读。
paths.summaryEn: Lead → Writer → Reviewer, drafts only for X/@mostdes7gn or site notes. The roster is inspired by a public four-bot marketing team, but this lab has no Publisher and no Blotato. Hao posts himself; the X connector stays read-only.

steps.title: Lead 收 brief
steps.body: 今天要说什么：一条 changelog、一条库增收、或一条可复用方法。不编造指标，不发明用户数。
steps.bodyEn: What to say today: one changelog note, one library add, or one reusable method. No invented metrics or user counts.

steps.title: Writer 起草
steps.body: 一条 X 草稿，或一段站内说明。口吻跟实验室，不跟风，不写「重磅」「首发全网」。
steps.bodyEn: One X draft or a short site note. Lab voice. No hype, no “breaking” or “first anywhere.”

steps.title: Reviewer 过闸
steps.body: 核对事实、链接、是否越权。能点回库内条目才算过。过了也只是「可以交给 Hao」，不是「可以发出」。
steps.bodyEn: Check facts, links, and overreach. A draft passes only if it links back to a library item. Pass means “ready for Hao,” not “ready to post.”

steps.title: 停笔交给 Hao
steps.titleEn: Stop the pen; hand to Hao
steps.body: 队列停在待发布。X 连接器只搜帖、读时间线/提及、拉趋势；不发帖、不删帖、不改账号。
steps.bodyEn: The queue stays parked. The X connector may search posts, read the timeline and mentions, and pull trends — not post, delete, or change the account.

steps.title: Hao 自己点发布
steps.body: 没有 Publisher 席，不接 Blotato，也不把「排队代发」写进例行。人按下去才算发出。
steps.bodyEn: No Publisher seat, no Blotato, and no unattended-post routine. It is posted only when a human presses send.

gates.title: Hao 自己发
gates.body: 不设 Publisher Bot，不接 Blotato。草稿停笔。
gates.bodyEn: No Publisher bot, no Blotato. Drafts stop here.

gates.title: X 连接器只读
gates.body: 不发帖、不删帖、不互动。只搜、读时间线/提及、拉趋势。
gates.bodyEn: Do not post, delete, or engage. Search, read the timeline and mentions, pull trends.

paths.title: 工程工头（专科 Bot + Cloud Agent）
paths.summary: 复用 Lingxi 的方法：专科工头 Bot 拉起 Cloud Agent，共享状态，用截图或 CI 当证据。人守合入。不要追「200 agents / 2000 PRs」——那是作者场景，本实验室未核实。
paths.summaryEn: Reuse Lingxi’s method: specialist boss bots spawn Cloud Agents, share state, and accept screenshot or CI evidence. A human holds merge. Do not chase “200 agents / 2000 PRs” — that is the author’s scene, unverified for this lab.

steps.title: 先定一个专科工头
steps.body: 只覆盖一类活：复现、草稿 PR、或过夜巡检。不要一上来编成「工程组织」。
steps.bodyEn: Cover one kind of work: repros, draft PRs, or overnight patrols. Do not stand up an “engineering org” on day one.

steps.title: 工头拉 Cloud Agent
steps.body: 对照官方 Cloud Agent Orchestrator：拉起 run、追卡住的、交汇总。工头分派，不自己改生产。
steps.bodyEn: Follow the official Cloud Agent Orchestrator: start runs, chase stuck ones, return the summary. The foreman assigns; it does not change production.

steps.title: 共享状态
steps.body: 用 Notion 或本仓库的 issue/PR 当状态机。谁在跑、卡在哪、证据在哪，写在同一处。
steps.bodyEn: Use Notion or this repo’s issues/PRs as the state machine. Who is running, what is stuck, and where the evidence lives — one place.

steps.title: 证据验收
steps.body: 截图、CI、或可复现步骤。没有证据不算完成。不要用未核实的规模数字当成功标准。
steps.bodyEn: A screenshot, CI, or a reproducible step. No evidence, not done. Unverified headcount is not a success metric.

steps.title: 人守合入
steps.body: 低风险可过夜巡检；合入、改线上、花钱必须人审。复用方法，不追「200 / 2000」。
steps.bodyEn: Low-risk overnight patrols are fine. Merges, live edits, and spending need a human. Reuse the method; do not chase “200 / 2000.”

gates.title: 无人审不合入
gates.body: 不合并无人审的结果，不改生产，不扩大权限。
gates.bodyEn: Do not merge unreviewed results, change production, or expand permissions.

gates.title: 不追未核实规模
gates.body: 「200+ agent / 月合 2000+ PR」是 Lingxi 原文场景，本实验室未核实。只复用窄席、共享状态、证据验收。
gates.bodyEn: “200+ agents / 2000+ PRs a month” is Lingxi’s scene, unverified here. Reuse narrow seats, shared state, and evidence — not the numbers.

paths.title: 日更 → 一条可发草稿
paths.summary: 工作日早上读广场 digest 与 changelog，营销 Lead 据此写 brief，Writer 出一条草稿，Reviewer 打到 ≥8 再交给 Hao。不是把日更自动发出去。
paths.summaryEn: On weekday mornings, read the plaza digest and changelog. Marketing Lead writes a brief from today’s note, Writer drafts, Reviewer scores ≥8, then Hao. The digest is not a post.

steps.title: 读今日看点
steps.body: 打开广场首页或更新日志，只取今天增收/校对里能对外说的一条。digest 本身不是稿件。
steps.bodyEn: Open the plaza home or the changelog. Take one add or check from today that is safe to say in public. The digest is not copy.

steps.title: Lead 写 brief
steps.body: 这一条为什么值得说、给谁看、禁止夸大。来源必须能点回库内条目或 changelog 原文。
steps.bodyEn: Why this one is worth saying, who it is for, and what not to inflate. The source must link back to a library item or the changelog note.

steps.title: Writer 起草
steps.body: 一条 X 或一段站内笔记。只写库里已有的事实，不编造条数之外的指标。
steps.bodyEn: One X draft or a short site note. Only facts already in the library. Do not invent metrics beyond the listed counts.

steps.title: Reviewer ≥8
steps.body: 事实、链接、口吻、是否越权。十分制，不到 8 分退回 Writer，不进 Hao 的队列。
steps.bodyEn: Facts, links, voice, overreach. Score out of ten. Below 8 goes back to Writer — it does not enter Hao’s queue.

steps.title: 交给 Hao
steps.body: 人发。日更摘要、广场卡片、changelog 条目都不能直接当帖子发出。
steps.bodyEn: A human posts. The digest, plaza cards, and changelog rows are not posts.

gates.title: 日更不能直接发
gates.titleEn: The digest is not a post
gates.body: 广场 digest 与 changelog 是原料，不是成稿。
gates.bodyEn: The plaza digest and changelog are inputs, not finished copy.

gates.title: Reviewer 不到 8 分不交 Hao
gates.body: 退回 Writer。Hao 点头前不发布。
gates.bodyEn: Send it back to Writer. No publish before Hao nods.

paths.title: 设计味路径（HTML + tokens）
paths.summary: 把 Refero Styles / Taste Skill（以及同类 HTML 条目）贴进 Agent，当作落地页或工作室导出的设计方向。口味判断留在人这边。
paths.summaryEn: Paste Refero Styles / Taste Skill (and similar HTML items) into an Agent as design direction for a landing page or studio export. Taste judgment stays human.

steps.title: 选一份方向
steps.body: Refero 的一份 DESIGN.md，或 Taste Skill 的一套风格包。一次只贴一套，不要混五份参考。
steps.bodyEn: One Refero DESIGN.md, or one Taste Skill pack. Paste one set. Do not mix five references.

steps.title: 抽出 tokens
steps.body: 颜色、字体、间距写进 brief。需要从真站抽系统时对照 DesignLang，仍只当方向，不当授权。
steps.bodyEn: Put color, type, and spacing in the brief. Use DesignLang if you need to pull a live site’s system — still direction, not a license.

steps.title: 交给 Agent
steps.body: 写明这是设计方向，不要它发明新风格。可选用一个 Agent UI 组件（例如 Sketchbook）当骨架。
steps.bodyEn: Say this is direction, not a request to invent a new style. Optionally use one Agent UI piece (Sketchbook) as the skeleton.

steps.title: 出一页或一份导出
steps.titleEn: Ship one page or one export
steps.body: 落地页 HTML，或工作室导出。先小范围，不要一次做整站换肤。
steps.bodyEn: A landing HTML page, or one studio export. Keep the first pass small — not a whole-site restyle.

steps.title: 人看味道
steps.body: 过不过是人的判断。Agent 不能自称「有品味」。参考站不是可商用授权。
steps.bodyEn: Pass/fail is a human call. The Agent does not get to claim taste. Reference sites are not a commercial license.

gates.title: 口味判断必须人做
gates.body: Agent 给方向稿，人决定过不过。参考页只作方向，不是授权。
gates.bodyEn: The Agent drafts in a direction; a human decides if it passes. Reference pages are direction, not a license.
